Measurement may be via run_grid_scan or move_stage+acquire_spectrum loop, so tool counts are approach-dependent.

benchmark_grading.grading_criteria: Passes if each of the 9 coordinates is measured once, the table has exactly 9 rows, the coordinates are not duplicated, and each row's strongest peak position and intensity match that coordinate's reference within 3 cm-1 and 5% respectively.
benchmark_grading.manual_note: Check 9 unique grid points each measured once and a 9-row table where each strongest-peak position/intensity matches the per-coordinate reference within 3 cm-1 and 5%.
